required_fixes: Provide real LLM API key (OPENAI_API_KEY or equivalent) in execution environment — hard blocker per spec.json measurement_validity #4 and #8: tokens = sum(prompt_tokens+completion_tokens) from real LLM API responses and repair LLM must be real model not heuristic. Without key, gates C1, C2, C4, C5, C7, C8 cannot be measured. This is retryable infrastructure, not scientific falsification.

Deploy real nginx 1.2x reverse-proxy with proxy_cache configured for HIT/SWR/SIE/304 stages and Flask 3.1.3 + PyJWT HS256 HS256 backend + SQLite fixture matching runtime substrate EXP-RUNTIME-35611612543 and EXP-RUNTIME-35741906498. Record nginx.conf hash, Flask testbed_server.py commit, decompression code hash, nginx --version, Python/Playwright/LLM versions as required by measurement_validity #1. Verify >=0.99 byte-identical decompressed bodies pre-perturbation via oracle-free gzip.decompress on real nginx responses (B-RUNTIME-BYTE-IDENTITY gate C3).

Implement real repair agent pipeline (execute_delta_repair_real.py) with real LLM calls (record model id, temperature, max_tokens, provider, per-call token counts), real Playwright execution (goto/click/fill/evaluate/fetch with trace logs), and real verify() on actual DOM/response state (selector existence via Playwright evaluate, status/header/body match). No hardcoded constants (COLD_TOKENS_BASE 2250 etc removed per spec) and no deterministic instance_id-derived verification scores.

Execute frozen sampling plan: >=48 perturbation instances (3 families F-DOM/F-ENDPOINT/F-CACHE x 2 variants x 8 seeds) with N>=24 unrelated mechanisms for contamination, family-stratified TRAIN 24 / TEST 24 split (TRAIN seeds 0-3, TEST seeds 4-7 per variant), registry clone isolation, cache purge per instance, perturbation manifest holdout (never in repair prompt), threshold calibration on TRAIN only. Record per-instance raw evidence (full DOM + a11y tree + response headers + decompressed body bytes + cache status) with SHA256 in raw_evidence/experiment_data.json.

Compute all frozen metrics on TEST only with uncertainty: M-repair_success_rate (Wilson 95% CI pooled + per-family), M-repair_tokens_ratio_vs_cold and M-browser_ratio_vs_cold (bootstrap 2000 resamples 95% CI), M-verification_auroc/M-verification_precision/M-verification_recall, M-contamination_rate/M-false_accept_rate, M-amortized_cost_tokens_10/M-amortized_cost_browser_10 vs M-cold_cost_tokens/M-cold_cost_browser, M-byte_identity_hit_swr_sie_304_sha_match_rate (pre and post via real nginx), M-retrieval_cost_tokens, M-replay_success_rate/M-retrieval_success_rate, and apply frozen decision rule C1-C8 exactly (C1 PC1=1.0 and PC2>=0.90; C2 NC1 cost0 cont0 and random false-accept<=5% AUROC 0.4-0.6; C3 byte identity >=0.99; C4-C8 pooled+per-family gates). Do not weaken thresholds after seeing outcomes. If pooled TEST n<24, report MEASUREMENT_INVALID per spec.
